How can we explore narrow spaces such as tunnels, caves, pipes, etc? 
In this project you will: 

• Explore how robots can be used to inspect narrow spaces
• Create and program a robot to move on a surface and avoid obstacles
• Test your program to make sure it can detect walls, holes, a cave, and objects
• Share your program and ideas
Get inspired by the Design Library base models to build your own solution to this project.
